what: The enum-match and embedded-MIR goldens were written by hand in commits that say they were never run (0653689e0d, 73789d7172), so they never matched what the translator emits on blaze MIR (chained per-arm discriminant tests into an i128 temporary, StorageLive/Dead). It read as MIR drift; the translator files and the match lowering are unchanged since then.
cost: a lane spent its first hour looking for a MIR commit that changed enum matches
cause: a golden landed without its test having run once, and nothing in the gate runs cargo test -p hir-ty-lean
workaround: git show <golden commit> for the translator and lowering files before assuming drift; regenerate with UPDATE_EXPECT and read each diff
